types.description: Three-pole thermal-magnetic motor breaker, rotary handle, 6–10 A adjustment, basic device

document.title: Schneider Electric Product data sheet — GV2P14

modelingNotes: Catalog spelling GV2P14; exact product photo on page 1 reads GV2-P14 / 6–10A, supporting the preserved source order spelling.

Thermal adjustment 6–10 A; magnetic release 138 A. No actual trip setting or assigned supply voltage is modeled. Conditional AC ratings and conductor limits are recorded in research.md using the 2017 manufacturer sheet.

Terminal keys follow the page 8 diagram; compact physical labels such as 1L1 correspond to diagram label 1/L1. Three thermal-magnetic poles are mechanically linked. Open state is the schematic OFF reference.

Basic breaker only; separately fitted auxiliary or release accessories are not included. Functions and mechanical relations do not create fixed electrical links. Trip curves and coordination are not simulated.

connectionCoverage.notes: Six main screw-clamp points in the exact product's applicable circuit diagram. No auxiliary, release, PE, neutral, shield or communications terminal is shown for this basic breaker; accessory assemblies are outside this order.
